title: Punjabi Bhindi Masala
description: Dry, spiced okra stir-fry with onions and tomatoes.

directions.text: Wash and completely dry the okra before chopping to prevent sliminess.
Fry okra in oil until slightly crispy. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onions, tomatoes, and spices. Add okra back in and cook for 5 mins.
